name: DriverHoursCompliancePanel
tagline: Review every driver's hours-of-service log, clear unassigned driving and document coaching – one Power Apps component for your safety team.
description: A complete hours-of-service (HOS) review app for carriers and private fleets. Loads daily driver logs (e.g. an ELD export), checks them against US 70/60-hour, Canada and EU / UK limits (driving, shift window, 30-minute break, cycle, off-duty reset), draws the 24-hour duty-status graph and turns violations, unassigned driving, uncertified logs and pending edits into a review workflow – new, in review, driver notified, coached, resolved – with validated rules, coaching records, hours-available clocks and a 14-day driver grid. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages. Review aid – not a certified ELD; validate against the regulations that apply to your fleet.
features: Four rulesets per log (US 70 h / 8 days, US 60 h / 7 days, Canada South cycle 1, EU / UK) with fleet-wide limit overrides
12 checks with fail / warn and next step; ELD vendor violations merged without double counting
24-hour duty-status graph from a simple Duty events text column
Hours, window and break calculated from duty events when hour columns are missing
Violation queue with type chips and the allowed next review steps
Unassigned driving triage by vehicle: assign to the driver or annotate with a reason (yard move over 60 min blocked)
Hours available: drive / window / cycle left per driver, Plan restart and Over cycle badges
14-day grid drivers × days coloured by result
Review board New → In review → Driver notified → Coached → Resolved with drag and drop and validated rules
Certification requests and confirmation, edit follow-up, coaching notes, driver annotations, coaching record (CoachingJson)
Grid with search, sort, grouping, bulk reviewer / notify / certification / resolve, CSV export, paging
Create / edit with validation, undo, back / forward
Power Fx outputs and six events; LogsCsv, ActionListJson, SummaryJson
controlType: standard (2 controls: niray_Niray.DriverHoursCompliancePanel data-set + niray_Niray.DriverHoursCompliancePanelPortal Power Pages)
